description: This file contains utility functions and data structures related to JSON parsing, string manipulation, color processing, error handling, and key normalization within the 'ai.openclaw.app.node' package. It is primarily used for handling data serialization, parsing parameters, and general utility operations across the application.

classes.name: Quad
classes.description: A generic data class representing a tuple of four elements, parameterized by types A, B, C, D.

methods.name: toJsonString
methods.description: Converts a string into a JSON-compatible escaped string.

methods.name: asObjectOrNull
methods.description: Casts a JsonElement to a JsonObject if possible, or returns null.

methods.name: parseJsonParamsObject
methods.description: Parses a JSON string into a JsonObject, returning null on failure.

methods.name: readJsonPrimitive
methods.description: Retrieves a JsonPrimitive value from a JsonObject by key.

methods.name: parseJsonInt
methods.description: Extracts an integer value from a JsonObject by key.

methods.name: parseJsonDouble
methods.description: Extracts a double value from a JsonObject by key.

methods.name: parseJsonString
methods.description: Retrieves a string value from a JsonObject by key.

methods.name: parseJsonBooleanFlag
methods.description: Parses a boolean value from a JsonObject by key, interpreting 'true' or 'false' strings.

methods.name: asStringOrNull
methods.description: Retrieves the string content from a JsonElement, or null if not applicable.

methods.name: parseHexColorArgb
methods.description: Converts a hex color string to a Long ARGB color value.

methods.name: invokeErrorFromThrowable
methods.description: Extracts an error code and message from a Throwable, utilizing an external parsing function.

methods.name: normalizeMainKey
methods.description: Trims and returns the main key string or null if empty.

methods.name: isCanonicalMainSessionKey
methods.description: Checks if a given key is exactly 'main', indicating a canonical main session key.
